question: Which NBA legend just got two million people to watch him golf?
story: LeBron James posted a ninety minute video of himself playing golf, and two million people watched it. According to TMZ and Sports Illustrated, the NBA legend has launched an entire YouTube channel dedicated to golf, and the very first video is a ten year reunion with his twenty sixteen Cleveland championship teammates. JR Smith. Tristan Thompson. Kevin Love. All of them in Scotland, at Castle Stuart Links, playing a full round on camera. Not a highlight reel. Ninety minutes of golf. Here is how the golf world is taking it. PGA Tour star Sam Burns was asked about it this week and reportedly said that as a fan of golf, having LeBron James supporting the game and growing it is great, pointing to the impact he has on people around the world. Burns also said he would happily play a round with him. So the invitation is out there. Publicly.
